# v2026.11.4

<!-- Written by scripts/release/changelog.mjs from CHANGELOG/2026.11.4.md. Do not edit it: the release cut writes it again. -->

AI agents and tools can read these release notes as [plain Markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arcforgelabs/flow/main/CHANGELOG/2026.11.4.md).

This release covers **8 pull requests.**

## Highlights

- A rule can offer an item to add to a job, such as shipping. A person adds it, or skips it with a reason that Flow records; the skip ends when the job changes and only item rules allow it. ([#490](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/490), [#493](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/493))
- Flow refuses a draft that Send would stop, and a held send can use the invoice that already exists in Xero. ([#488](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/488))
- Finished jobs with no invoice stay visible and get flagged. ([#486](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/486))
- A second assistant key acts as its own Flow person, so two assistants each have their own access and record. ([#492](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/492))
- An assistant's back-to-back calls are no longer refused while its last call writes its audit. ([#491](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/491))

## Changes

- A rule can offer an item to add to a job, such as shipping. A person adds it, or skips it with a reason that Flow records; the skip ends when the job changes and only item rules allow it. The assistant skill shares Flow links. ([#490](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/490), [#493](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/493))
- A second assistant key acts as its own Flow person. ([#492](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/492))

## Fixes

- Flow refuses a draft that Send would stop, and a held send can use the invoice that already exists in Xero. ([#488](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/488))
- Finished jobs with no invoice stay visible and get flagged. ([#486](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/486))
- An assistant's back-to-back calls are no longer refused while its last call writes its audit. ([#491](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/491))
